component.name: CamDroid Studio
component.summary: Use your Android phone as a webcam

description.p: CamDroid Studio turns an Android phone into a high-quality webcam and microphone for your desktop. It discovers the phone over Wi-Fi or USB, decodes the hardware H.264/H.265 stream, and publishes it through v4l2loopback and PulseAudio on Linux.
On Windows and macOS the app runs as a standalone preview and camera controller, since those platforms do not provide v4l2loopback.
